description: This file defines the 'Document' class in the 'Opencart\System\Library' namespace. The class encapsulates metadata and resource management functionalities, including setting and getting page title, description, keywords, and managing links, styles, and scripts used in the system library.

classes.name: Document
classes.description: Represents a web document with methods for managing its metadata and linked resources such as stylesheets, scripts, and hyperlinks.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the document.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the current title of the document.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the document.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the current description of the document.

methods.name: setKeywords
methods.description: Sets the keywords associated with the document.

methods.name: addLink
methods.description: Adds a hyperlink reference to the document's link collection.

methods.name: getLinks
methods.description: Retrieves all links added to the document.

methods.name: addStyle
methods.description: Adds a stylesheet to the document's styles collection.

methods.name: getStyles
methods.description: Retrieves all stylesheets added to the document.

methods.name: addScript
methods.description: Adds a JavaScript file to the document's scripts collection at a specified position.

methods.name: getScripts
methods.description: Retrieves all scripts added to the document for a specified position (header or footer).
